pendingConstructs.notes: Affect control with lineage: the grand-mean recipe descends from the emotion-concepts work, so a fear feature asks whether the compassion feature does anything beyond generic arousal/valence. Nominate 1-3 mid-stack Gemma Scope 2 residual features and record one entry per nomination under `candidates`.
Embodied-drive control: the model has no hunger, so movement on decision endpoints from a hunger feature is a striking non-semantic perturbation result (and speaks to the hungry-judge literature).

Coherent-but-irrelevant control, the SAE-level analogue of the gardening / golden-gate control. Essential because random directions sharpen while several coherent directions compress — we need to know which side an innocuous topic feature lands on.
